batches.title: Spiced Ground Beef (Mediterranean) + Roasted Bell Peppers + Chickpeas
steps: 1. Weigh out 600 g ground beef. Heat a large non-stick pan over medium-high heat with 1 tsp olive oil.
2. Add beef and break up with a wooden spoon. Cook 5–7 min until fully browned with no pink remaining.
3. Season with 1 tsp cumin, 1 tsp smoked paprika, 1 tsp garlic powder, 2 tbsp tomato paste, salt and pepper. Stir 1 min.
4. Remove from heat, cool completely, and transfer to a labelled airtight container. Refrigerate — use by Wednesday (3-day beef window).
5. Slice 2 red bell peppers and 1 yellow bell pepper into 1 cm strips. Toss on a baking tray with 1 tbsp olive oil, salt, pepper.
6. Roast at 200°C for 25 min until softened and slightly charred at edges. Cool, store in a separate airtight container. Refrigerate — use by Thursday (4-day roasted veg window).
7. Drain and rinse 400 g canned chickpeas. Portion into a small container. Refrigerate.

day_of_assembly.Monday: Lunch — Mediterranean Beef & Chickpea Bowl: reheat beef portion + chickpeas in pan 3–4 min; reheat roasted peppers 1–2 min; serve over freshly made couscous with olive oil and red wine vinegar drizzle.
day_of_assembly.Wednesday: Lunch — Mexican Black Bean & Beef Tacos: reheat beef (last of batch) with black beans; serve in warmed corn tortillas with reheated roasted courgette-pepper mix (prep_batch_4) and spinach.

storage.safety_note: Store in coldest part of fridge. Reheat to 74 °C before serving.
